install_tell: lmdeploy serve api_server internlm/internlm2_5-7b-chat --server-port 23333  # or: docker run -p 23333:23333 openmmlab/lmdeploy:latest
misconfig_patterns: api_keys parameter Default to None, which means no authentication required (api_server.py:1486)
Swagger UI mounted at / (docs_url='/') — interactive API explorer exposed to anyone (api_server.py:1543)
/openapi.json publicly enumerates every route and request schema
/terminate endpoint accepts GET — INFERRED denial-of-service when reachable
/distserve/p2p_initialize / p2p_connect / p2p_drop_connect — disaggregated-serving P2P control plane exposed
/v1/encode — raw token-ID round-trip leaks tokenizer behavior and chat template
0.0.0.0 default server_name binds all interfaces on port 23333 (api_server.py:1431)
/health returns 200 OK with no auth, surfaces server liveness
/metrics exposed under --enable-metrics — lmdeploy: prefixed Prometheus metrics surface GPU cache use, request counts

active_probe.false_positive_check: openapi.json must contain at least 2 of: /distserve/*, /v1/encode, /v1/chat/interactive, /is_sleeping — these route names are LMDeploy-unique (not in vLLM, SGLang, TGI, AIBrix)

secondary_probe.note: Only present when --enable-metrics flag set at launch; absence does not refute LMDeploy

deployment_tells: Swagger UI HTML served at root / by FastAPI (docs_url='/')
TurboMind backend or PyTorch backend selector visible in startup logs
/openapi.json title field contains 'LMDeploy' or model name
Anthropic-compat router mounted alongside OpenAI router (/v1/messages endpoints)
Distinctive route family: /distserve/* for prefill/decode disaggregation
Prometheus metrics with lmdeploy: prefix when --enable-metrics set
pivot_paths: GET / -> Swagger UI HTML -> click 'Try it out' executes against the same server with no auth
GET /openapi.json -> full route + schema dump including model name in info section
GET /v1/models -> served model name (often org/model from HuggingFace) -> attribution + HF account pivot
POST /v1/chat/completions with model from /v1/models -> verify unauth inference -> compute cost theft + prompt-injection surface
POST /v1/encode -> tokenizer probe reveals chat template structure and any system prompt leak via render
GET /distserve/engine_info -> reveals tensor parallel size, kv cache config, backend type (turbomind vs pytorch)
GET /metrics -> lmdeploy:gpu_cache_usage_perc + lmdeploy:num_requests_running -> infer GPU footprint
POST /sleep then /wakeup -> denial-of-service pivot (model unloaded mid-traffic)
POST /update_weights -> if URL/path scheme exposed, model-substitution attack — INFERRED, needs source verification on accepted payload
Anthropic-compat /v1/messages endpoint mounted on same port — second auth surface, same null default

Platform itself NOT verified live at these IPs — these are lateral mentions per Insight #95, not LMDeploy instances. Status stays CANDIDATE.

notes: Auth-on-default OFF — direct quote from api_server.py:1486: 'Default to None, which means no' authentication. 7890 stars, very active (push 2026-06-09), Shanghai AI Lab + MMRazor/MMDeploy. The /distserve/* and /v1/encode and /v1/chat/interactive routes are unique enough that an openapi.json fetch is the cleanest single-probe fingerprint. Highest-yield Shodan dork because port 23333 is non-standard — minimal background noise. Anthropic-compat router added 2026 expands attack surface.
